dialogue.content: こんにちはメンタルトレーナー：受験ですよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm a mental trainer specializing in entrance exams. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: お願い致します。
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you, too.

dialogue.content: 本日はどういったご相談でしょうか
dialogue.English: How can I help you today?

dialogue.content: もう時間が無いのですがやる気が出ません
dialogue.English: I’m running out of time, but I can’t get motivated.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それはしんどいですよね。。
dialogue.English: I see, that must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今、どういったことに取り組んでおられますか
dialogue.English: What are you currently working on?

dialogue.content: 朝早く起きて3時間勉強します
dialogue.English: I get up early in the morning and study for three hours.

dialogue.content: やる気でないと感じる中でもとても頑張っておられるのですね
dialogue.English: Even though you feel unmotivated, you're working very hard.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 差し支えなければ、何の試験に挑戦しておられるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: If you don’t mind my asking, what exam are you preparing for?

dialogue.content: 高校受験です
dialogue.English: It's the high school entrance exam.

dialogue.content: 確かに今とても大切な時期ですよね
dialogue.English: Indeed, this is a very important time right now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やる気でないということですが、どんなところに一番困っておられますか
dialogue.English: You mentioned a lack of motivation—what aspect is most challenging for you?

dialogue.content: 目指す学校は無理だと思うんですがレベルを落とすと女子校になるのが嫌です
dialogue.English: I think the school I’m aiming for is out of reach, but if I lower the level, it would be a girls’ school, which I don’t want.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、自分の目指す高校に入れたらと考えると嬉しいですよね
dialogue.English: I see. It would feel great to imagine getting into the high school you’re aiming for, wouldn’t it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 共学にいくのが、自分にとってはいいかなと思われるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Do you feel that going to a co-ed school would be a good fit for you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ここでは、レベル落とさずに共学の学校にどうしたら行けるか 　を一緒に考えるというこうでよいでしょうか
dialogue.English: Shall we think together about how you can get into a co-ed school without lowering the level?

dialogue.content: はいお願い致します
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 目指しておられる学校は無理かもということですが、試験か何かで評価が出ているということでしょうか
dialogue.English: You mentioned the school you're aiming for might be out of reach. Is that based on test results or some other evaluation?

dialogue.content: そうです♪頭が悪いからなかなか結果が出ません
dialogue.English: That's right. I’m not very smart, so results don’t come easily.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、でも朝3時間の勉強を続けているのは、とてもすごいことだと私は思いますよ
dialogue.English: I understand. Still, I think it’s really impressive that you’ve been consistently studying for three hours every morning.

dialogue.content: でもやはり結果が出ない
dialogue.English: But I'm still not getting the results.

dialogue.content: うんうん結果がついてこないのは、しんどいですよね…
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. It’s really hard when the results don’t follow, isn’t it?

dialogue.content: 他の人の3倍やるしか無いと思うけれど
dialogue.English: I feel like I have no choice but to work three times harder than everyone else, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: やる気が出ないということでしたが、ご自身ではそこはどんな感じなのでしょうか
dialogue.English: You mentioned you don't feel motivated; could you tell me a little more about what that feels like for you?

dialogue.content: どうせ　私なんかって思うのかなぁ
dialogue.English: I guess I just think things like, 'Someone like me can't do it anyway.'

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 私なんかって・・・
dialogue.English: 'Someone like me...'

dialogue.content: 思ってしまうのですね・・・
dialogue.English: You end up thinking that...

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もし、目指す高校に入れた自分って想像してみたらどんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: If you imagine yourself having gotten into the school you’re aiming for, what would that feel like?

dialogue.content: 好きな習い事をしながらも楽しく
dialogue.English: I'd be having fun while also doing the extracurriculars I love.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 好きな習い事をやりながらイキイキしている感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: So you'd feel vibrant and full of life, doing the activities you enjoy?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんな自分になれたらとても嬉しいですよね
dialogue.English: It would be wonderful to become that version of yourself, wouldn’t it?

dialogue.content: 自分は何ならば出来るかなぁと考えております
dialogue.English: I've been thinking about what it is I can actually do.

dialogue.content: これからの目標を考える大事な時間を過ごされているのですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're spending this important time thinking about your future goals.

dialogue.content: はい　だからこそ受験が大事だと思う
dialogue.English: Yes, that's why I think these exams are so important.

dialogue.content: うんうん、本当にそうですよね！
dialogue.English: Yes, I completely agree!

dialogue.content: お勉強はダメだけど気配りは出来る
dialogue.English: I may not be good at studying, but I am considerate of others.

dialogue.content: 今、難しいレベルの高校を目指されていますが、結果がでず苦しんでおられます。
dialogue.English: Right now, you're aiming for a challenging high school, and you're struggling because you're not getting the results you want.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも、それは真剣に自分の将来のことを考えるからこそ、そこにチャレンジする価値を感じておられるのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: But perhaps it's precisely because you're thinking so seriously about your future that you feel this challenge is worth taking on.

dialogue.content: そうか
dialogue.English: Maybe so.

dialogue.content: はい、私はそう感じました！
dialogue.English: Yes, that's the impression I got!

dialogue.content: 具体的に試験日はいつでしょうか
dialogue.English: Specifically, when are your exam dates?

dialogue.content: 2月のうちに3日あって25日に終わります
dialogue.English: I have three exam days in February, finishing on the 25th.

dialogue.content: あともう少しの間頑張れば　というところですね
dialogue.English: So it's just a little while longer that you need to push through.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 合格までのサブゴールを設定したいのですが、
dialogue.English: I’d like to set some sub-goals on the way to passing, if that’s alright.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 2月受験として2月の受験日までに模試は何回くらいありますか？
dialogue.English: Since the exams are in February, how many mock exams do you have between now and then?

dialogue.content: 3回
dialogue.English: Three.

dialogue.content: 3回ですね、そこでどれくらいの点を取らないといけないのかを学校の先生や塾の先生に相談してみるのはどうですか
dialogue.English: Three—how about consulting your school or cram school teachers about what scores you need to be aiming for on those?

dialogue.content: 解りましたー
dialogue.English: Okay, I will!

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Good.

dialogue.content: そこで必要な点数を具体化していくのです
dialogue.English: That way, you can make the scores you need more concrete.

dialogue.content: やってみる
dialogue.English: I’ll give it a try.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました😊
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. 😊

dialogue.content: 時間になりました、ご相談有難うございました
dialogue.English: Our time is up now. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: 終了させていただきます
dialogue.English: This concludes our session.
